propositions: Identical allowlisted tool calls waste 40-70% of request budget by re-executing the same signature repeatedly instead of returning a cached result on the first re-occurrence.

Error-prefixed return strings (transient failures) must NOT be memoized and must re-execute on retry, whereas deterministic sentinel-empty strings like '(no matches)' must be memoized to eliminate pathological loops like the observed 62x repetition.

A memoization wrapper at the agent-call seam must emit escalating static nudges (level-1 on first repeat, level-2 thereafter) to steer the model away from duplicate calls without altering provider prompt-caching byte-stability.
The runaway guard's distinct-ratio window must continue to observe every memoized duplicate signature so that pathological loops still trip the abort backstop at the same call index.
Only read-only allowlisted tools (read_file, search_files, list_directory, show_ticket) are memoized; write and non-deterministic tools like record_criterion_verdict always execute.

The wrapper order must be guard (outermost) → memo → steering (innermost) so the guard's call_tool observes the signature before memo short-circuits and concurrent tool-call batches acquire per-signature locks.
